reviews.t: I am happy I discovered this brand.
reviews.x: If you have pets, this is a must.  My older cat get bruises from scratching.  I put on skin, and days later the wounds are healed. Every vet needs to promote this product.
Amazing. bought a turkey that ass neglected with a severe breeding injury. pic is of it all scabbed up and no infection after 7 days!

so far I have just used to condition legs and crest of chickens to protect from frost and mites. Works great. My chicken keeping friend has used this to cure bumble foot on one of her birds when caught early.

Great stuff! I've even used it on myself without fail. I love that it's all natural so when my pups lick it nothing seriously adverse chemical reaction is going to happen. Works pretty damn good to. Definitely will buy over and over again. I have 1 in the pups training bag and one in house.

This stuff was a miracle. My husband and I rescued a dog and learned he'd had chemicals poured on him, which caused sores. They've mostly healed but they became itchy and his hai was falling out. This stuff helped stop his itchiness and helped his skin heal.

I love this for my puppy. She is young and playful which means she gets into everything! She has had some ant bites and small cuts on her paw. She will of course try to lick it but it make me glad to know it won’t harm her since it’s all natural.

reviews.t: Great for Scaley Leg mites on Chickens.
reviews.x: This is a great product for scaley leg mites on chickens. I applied it on the first day that I received it and it so far it looks like it is working. This really helped one of my chickens that had bad scaley leg mites. After a week or so my chicken looked happier and almost all of the mites were suffocated from the ointment. I would recommend this to everyone that has some sort of poultry. I will always have an extra one just in case.

reviews.t: ... protecting waffles and combs from frostbite over winter as recommended by a blogger I follow
reviews.x: Added to my chicken first aid kit for protecting waffles and combs from frostbite over winter as recommended by a blogger I follow. :)
Use it for self inflicted bird plucking wound.

I've tried so many different gels, ointments, etc for my German Shepherd 's paws over the last 3 years, and this is it! Her paws get so rough and swollen, it's heartbreaking. After the first application of Green Goo, she's up and running, sliding across my hardwood floors to get to door!
I used it on my dog who suffers from dry skin and allergies this stuff is awesome used it to the last drop ordered another one

reviews.t: Easy and safe to use for both people and dogs!
reviews.x: Bought this as a moisturizing balm for a rescue doggo that was healing from burns. It was a really good step between the bandaged medicated healing and the final uncovered healed skin. The medicated cream wasn’t something that was safe for him to lick after he was finally able to be without the big donut around his neck, this was something that was safe and it helped him to continue to heal well. All the ingredients are safe and it goes on very easily and you can rub it in well for moisturizing

We bought this for our black lab’s chronic dry nose and use it nightly. It doesn’t solve the issue but it definitely keeps painful cracking at bay. Recently we had the opportunity to try the salve on a paw pad cut and it was great for that. I think it helped the healing to move along at a good pace.

My German Shepard is allergic to flea bites.  No matter what meds you use, it's going to happen..... this ointment keeps her from digging at the site and promotes her skins health.  She will bring the tub to have it put on!
Amazing heals wounds fast!! Used it on my chicken who had a terrible head wound!!

reviews.t: May work for small cuts and irritation but not for what I purchased it for
reviews.x: Very strong smell and it seemed to bother my dogs and was not thick enough

So glad I purchased this product. Took care of all my fur babies cuts and scarps quickly. Our house will never be without Green Goo Animal First Aid. As a result of this product I purchase other products by Green Goo with the same amazing results. So glad I found a product this is all natural, so worth the money spent.

reviews.t: It works for very dry skin.
reviews.x: My cat has flaky dry skin. This has made him so happy! I put extra on my hands and was surprised how it soothed my dry and painfully raw hands. The scent is not so pleasant at first but soon goes away.

reviews.t: A must for the first aid kit!
reviews.x: This stuff is awesome!  I have used it on multiple wounds on chickens and had amazing and fast results!  Definitely a must for your animal first aid kit.
I was able to treat my cat and dog with success.

I had been treating a hen with a large hole in its backside caused by being attacked by a predator for almost a month. I was given green goo when nothing was working.  To my surprise, within a week the quarter size hole was completely healed and she was returned to her flock.  I love this product!

I used this on my doggo's scratched nose.  He scratches it due to allergies and a pre-existing condition.  This is the only cream that works.  I've taken him to several different vets over the years for help and we've tried topical and oral steroids and this cream does more than they do.

My birds had somehow gotten scaley mites. I used this on all their feet for a few days and it pretty much cleared it up. It lasts a long time and is a great product. I also used it on a cut my bird got on his wing and like a day later, it was healing up nicely. I highly recommend.

My dog has skin issues and was chewing himself till he was raw and blood red. I started using this daily and the affected areas cleared up in a week.  My vet wanted me to put him on anti-depressants costing $100 a month, I said "no thanks" and bought this stuff.

This stuff is a miracle. My pup gets bad black fly bites in early summer. The bites become so red and swollen. We end up putting this all over her almost every night and by morning, her bites are barely noticable. I will always keep this stuff around.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the product for healing wounds and skin issues on animals, including dogs, cats, and chickens.
Many customers value that it is all-natural and safe if pets lick it.
It is frequently used and recommended for chickens, including for frost protection, mites, and bumble foot.
Several reviewers report success treating dogs' skin problems such as dry skin, allergies, itchy paws, and dry noses.
A few reviewers note it manages symptoms rather than fully solving the underlying issue.
